title: Strategic Recruitment, Interviewing & Selection
overview: Recruitment and selection teams face increasing pressure to deliver more with fewer resources. As a result, innovative recruitment channels and advanced branding techniques are no longer optional but essential. The diversification of selection methods is critical for improving the reliability of hiring decisions and ensuring higher-quality hires. Additionally, using performance metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) has become standard practice to measure the effectiveness of recruitment and selection processes. This course is continuously updated to reflect these evolving trends and provide participants with the latest tools and strategies for successful talent acquisition.
audience: This course is designed for experienced and senior professionals in recruitment and selection, as well as senior human resources staff. It is also highly beneficial for those involved in workforce planning and nationalization initiatives.
methodology: The course is structured into three main sections: recruitment, interviewing, and selection. Each section explores current trends and best practices, enabling participants to assess and improve their organization's recruitment processes.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop workforce plans that are aligned with company strategies and market conditions
Utilize diverse recruitment channels to maximize efficiency and reduce costs
Create specialized selection frameworks for various job roles, enhancing their reliability and validity
Conduct competency-based interviews and apply best practices in candidate assessment
Implement KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness of recruitment and selection processes
Design and analyze exit interviews to gain insights for future improvements
